resources.string: FingerScroll shows a small floating scroll pad. Move your finger slightly up or down on the pad and FingerScroll scrolls the app on screen for you, so you can scroll long pages with a tiny thumb movement. The service is used only to show the pad and to perform scroll gestures and scroll actions in the app you are using. It does not read, store or send your messages, typing, passwords or any other screen content, and the app has no internet access.
Scroll any app with a tiny finger movement
